sentences: An entropy region collects all joint-entropy vectors realizable by random variables.
The recorded question concerns approximating its faces using variables with bounded alphabets.
A face can encode equalities or limiting relationships that finite-support approximations may struggle to preserve exactly.
A suitable alphabet bound could make otherwise unbounded information-theoretic optimization more accessible to certified computation.

The saved title does not state which faces, approximation metric, or alphabet dependence are intended, so it remains essential to distinguish approximating a nearby entropy vector from staying on the prescribed face.
